title: Isaiah Likely on impending free agency: I just want to blossom

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Isaiah Likely on impending free agency: I just want to blossom
sources.description: Tight end Isaiah Likely's hopes for a breakout 2025 season with the Ravens were hindered by a preseason foot injury, but he hasn't lost sight of that goal as he gets closer to becoming a free agent for the first time in the NFL.
